content.value: Determine the limiting envelope for tendon of simply suppórted pretensioned (23) l-beam for a parking garage with draped in a parabolic shape of span 65 ft. The beam has to carry a superimposed sustained service live load of 1100 plf. and superimposed dead load. of 100 plf. Assume the beam, is made of normal weight concrete with $f _ { c } ^ { \prime } = 6 0 0 0 .$ psi and that the concrete strength $f _ { c i } ^ { \prime }$ at transfer is 75% of the cylinder strength. Assume also that the time dependent losses of the initial prestress are 18 percent of the initial prestress and that $f _ { p u } = 2 7 0 0 0 0$ psi for stress-relieved tendons of area 2.907 in², $e _ { c } = 1 3$ in and $e _ { e } = 6$ in. Consider the mid-span, quarter-span and beam ends as the controlling sections. Also determine the limiting. envelope. for tendon location' such that the limiting: concrete fiber stresses are at time exceeded.
